# Spatial sampling summary correction

**Complete within assigned scope. Controller review and post-fix media checks remain.**

## Revisions and scope

- BASE: `498c717d53240d15a29396830759a571a938f492`
- HEAD: `e5aeb3e7cb83e23f12a9255df018e25a76cc8c0e`
- Commit: `fix(video): populate spatial sampling totals`
- Candidate source: `38c12b84bbbe3ab14171946e12b702ceb0fe2e5805504015352b0f6bedf5fdb9`
- Worktree: `/Users/juanpablosarmiento/src/worktrees/avandar/feat/motion-catalog`

Only these three tracked files changed, relative to `apps/ava-video-producer/`:

1. `src/stock/presets/StratifiedSpatialSample/SampleCopy.tsx`: derive aggregate quantities from the existing validated collections, animate them with shared helpers, and reserve unit clearance.
2. `src/stock/presets/StratifiedSpatialSample/StratifiedSpatialSample.tsx`: pass the existing frame into the private caption component. Formatter also sorts existing imports.
3. `src/stock/presets/StratifiedSpatialSample/StratifiedSpatialSample.test.ts`: assert painted integer output, timing and text clearance using the real renderer. Formatter also sorts existing imports.

No tracked production files outside the assigned directory changed. No metadata, schema, fixtures, controls, registry, shared renderer, public API, or translation behavior changed. Report, logs, requests and generated evidence remain local and ignored. No push, merge, PR or publication occurred.

## Root cause and correction

The native historical hold renders Selected, Eligible sites and Not selected without quantities. `SampleCopy` previously received only input and returned authored copy through `LabelSlots`; it had no frame or numeric output. The upper per-stratum fractions were already correct. I personally viewed the historical native hold in `final-mp4-default-016`, SHA-256 `b63ad64fb85a453fd71aadaa87009af71e1a11aa3a65c29e1a0e87f4f658f43a`, confirming the omission independently of source inspection.

The selected total is `selectedSiteIds.length`, eligible is `sites.length`, and unselected is their difference. Existing validation guarantees unique selected IDs that reference eligible sites. Shared `countTo`, `ramp`, `STAGGER` and `Text` introduce the numbers at frames 108, 110 and 112, after sampling resolves. All three settle by frame 140. Their fixed 24px baseline is 552 in the 960 x 600 SVG. Authored headings keep their slots at 490; the authored unit moves from 570 to 578. Map geometry, anchors, keys, per-stratum fractions and zero-selected denominators stay intact.

The controller corrected the brief's globally empty example because the existing public schema requires at least one selected ID. The accepted one-stratum-empty fixture uses `['a']`. No schema was widened and no bypassed globally empty input was introduced.

| Accepted case | Selected | Eligible | Unselected | Retained stratum evidence |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Default | 2 | 5 | 3 | West 1/3, East 1/2 |
| One stratum unsampled | 1 | 5 | 4 | West 1/3, East 0/2 |
| All five sites selected | 5 | 5 | 0 | West 3/3, East 2/2 |
| Existing dense fixture | 8 | 12 | 4 | 3/3, 3/3, 2/3, 0/3 |

## Red/green and scoped checks

Commands below ran from the producer directory unless specified otherwise. `REMOTION_KEYS_FILE` pointed to the main checkout's `apps/ava-video-producer/.env.local`. Its contents were never opened, printed or copied.

The exact RED invocation's arguments were:

```sh
node --import ./scripts/require-license.mjs --import tsx \
  --test src/stock/presets/StratifiedSpatialSample/StratifiedSpatialSample.test.ts
```

RED: exit 1, 17 tests, 12 passed and 5 expected failures. Four held-output cases produced no painted integer text (`[]`) instead of 2/5/3, 1/5/4, 5/5/0 and 8/12/4; the intermediate reading-phase test found zero quantities. The clearance test and all 11 existing tests passed. This directly established the missing visible output rather than just validating arithmetic or marker attributes.

The RED command imported the license module, whose main-only guard does not run on import. It launched no browser or telemetry. Subsequent final tests explicitly invoked the shared guard before the test runner:

```sh
node scripts/require-license.mjs && node --import tsx \
  --test src/stock/presets/StratifiedSpatialSample/StratifiedSpatialSample.test.ts
```

GREEN: exit 0, 17 tests passed, 0 failed. Final duration 1605.945ms. Painted-text extraction accounts for actual SVG text, inherited opacity and fill. Existing fixture seeks, semantics, anchor retention, schema rejection, whole-grapheme copy, all-frame canvas bounds and prefix tests remain green. Expected totals are independently specified literals. No global snapshots or duplicate arithmetic oracle were added.

All scoped checks below exited 0:

- **Producer typechecks and gallery rebuild:** `pnpm run typecheck`, including the guarded pretypecheck gallery build. Both TypeScript projects passed.
- **ESLint:** `pnpm exec eslint` on the three changed paths, from repository root. No diagnostics.
- **Formatting:** `pnpm exec oxfmt --ignore-path .oxfmtignore --check` on those paths, from repository root. All 3 matched files formatted.
- **React Doctor:** producer project, `--yes --verbose --scope changed --base 498c717d53240d15a29396830759a571a938f492 --no-score`. Three files scanned, no issues.
- **Diff integrity:** `git diff --check`. No whitespace errors.

An initial formatting invocation without `--ignore-path` matched no files because of the repository's inverted Prettier ignore. The explicit scoped check above replaced it. React Doctor's current CLI uses changed scope instead of the skill's older `--diff` flag. Score was disabled, so no numerical health-score comparison is claimed. No whole unit or E2E suite was repeated.

Logs are under `apps/ava-video-producer/.temp/`, prefixed `sampling-summary-`: `red.log`, `green.log`, `green-final.log`, `typecheck.log`, `eslint.log`, `format.log`, `react-doctor.log`, `preview-default.log`, `preview-dense.log`, and `stills.log`.

The configured request contains the unchanged existing dense fixture and default accent/background. Public previews use the six standard frames 0/18/36/90/150/179 and 1280 x 800 output. Both complete manifests bind the candidate source hash above.

Supplemental exact-input final-hold stills and their source/configuration manifest are in repository-root `.temp/feat-motion-catalog/sampling-summary/`. The guarded supplemental script used one headless browser and awaited each renderStill serially, with empty browser environment variables. Source verification passed before and after. The script closed its browser and removed its bundle in `finally`.

I personally viewed each of the ten candidate images listed below, one actual image per tool call. Both contact sheets, both full-size frame-90 images and both full-size frame-150 images were inspected. I additionally viewed default/dense final holds at 164 and the accepted one-stratum-empty/all-selected holds at 150. Frame 90 correctly retains the existing headings without the later quantities. The reading holds show the expected totals below the captions, clear of the map and unit. Dense authored labels remain readable and inside the canvas. The 0/2 and 0/3 per-stratum denominators and all site keys remain visible. No concrete new defect was observed in those stills.
